469.frame: DECODE R7397 images P1 and P2 (I33666)
469.saw: Photos of a bound volume. P1: one sheet with 8 lines of symbol cipher (hooks, hash marks, 'm'/'w'-like glyphs, bars) in the upper half, rest blank. P2: full page of about 28 dense lines of the same symbol cipher, with word-break marks (slashes). Same system on both; no plaintext or decipherment on either; adjacent pages with the same signs are visible at the edges. Record says 3 pp., only 2 images are attached.
469.note: Third page not among the images.

637.frame: viewer image 133 of 329 (pp. 18-19 of the volume); the catalogue's 'frame 0134' is the same leaf, numbered one higher
637.saw: Handwritten despatch, spread with Appleton's text about Yandiola and the loan. Two lines of number groups in the body at the foot of the left page: '1088 648 [sign] 1576 794 [sign] 1384 1453 347 1372 500 / 192 668 1384 169 1244 1501 1110 1426 1290' (668 as printed by Manning, not 168); no decipherment written on the page. Plain English follows on the right page ('Yandiola inquired then when Mr. Nelson might come'). Frames 134-136 show the same despatch with no code groups.
